verdict.rationale: The Employee Incentives and Benefits page confirms the firm advises on equity incentive schemes and lists UK-specific factsheets (EMI, Growth Shares, Company Share Option Plans, Share Incentive Plans), directly matching the UK EMI portion of the story. However, there is no evidence of German VSOP/ESOP or Indian ESOP-specific offerings or content, which the story explicitly names. Missing for 10: documentation of German VSOP/ESOP schemes, documentation of Indian ESOP schemes, any cross-jurisdictional equity plan design tool or guide analogous to the term sheet/SCC generators.
